explanation: The conflict’s own lead dates its beginning to the partition of Ottoman Syria and the dissolution of the Ottoman Empire after the war. The article reads: "By 1920, sectarian conflict had begun following the first, second, and third waves of Zionist migration to Palestine and the Franco-British occupation and administration (1918–1920) of the former territories of Ottoman Syria (1516–1918) and the dissolution of the Ottoman Empire after World War I."
